description: Pretty print, minify or validate JSON. Formatting and minifying only change whitespace; key order, values and structure stay exactly as they were. Returns the output text or a clear parse error. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/json-formatter/

mode.description: 'format' to pretty print, 'minify' to strip whitespace, 'validate' to only check validity (default format)
